header: THE SUBJECT IS A PERSON (step 63b; my rule, 31 Oct 2026): "pax number", "phone number" and "contact number" are one keyword. When the thing asked about is a department or any other non-human entity the answer is its PAX number (answer.ts); when it is a HUMAN BEING who is an EXECUTIVE (a six-digit ticket that starts with 4) the number asked for is his or her CUG MOBILE number. This file is the person half. PURE: no database. What it does NOT change: how the number is shown. The CUG number is masked on the card (943479xxxx) and the full number comes only through the existing Reveal button, which needs a login and writes the audit row (/api/employees/[id]/reveal, contact_access_log). I never print a full number here: the answer puts the masked number first. I take a person ONLY when every word the person typed is a WHOLE word of the stored name ("sanjay roy" = SANJAY KUMAR ROY). The directory's own name search is fuzzy and phonetic on purpose, which is right for a people search and wrong for deciding that a question is about a person at all: "contact number of water pump" must not turn into somebody with a similar-sounding name. A non-executive is NOT answered here (I gave no rule for them): the question goes on to the other routes exactly as before.

symbols.name: TITLES
doc: Titles that I drop because they are not part of the stored name.

symbols.name: MAX_NAME_WORDS
doc: I allow a name at most this many words; a longer subject is a sentence, not a name, and I run no name search for it.

symbols.name: MAX_PEOPLE
doc: I show at most this many executives for one name ("kumar" is hundreds).
